description: This bar chart illustrates the CoLeG-R (%) performance metric for two LLaMA models, LLaMA-2-13B and LLaMA-2-70B, under four different fine-tuning conditions, with the horizontal axis representing the model variants and the vertical axis representing the CoLeG-R (%) score ranging from 0 to 80 in linear increments. Each model has four grouped bars corresponding to different SFT (Supervised Fine-Tuning) configurations: “no SFT” (light blue with diagonal stripes), “+ SFT on D₀” (light orange with horizontal stripes), “+ SFT on D₀, D₁” (light purple with diagonal stripes), and “+ SFT on D₀, D₁, D₂” (solid salmon pink). For both models, the bars are arranged in ascending order of performance from left to right, with the “no SFT” bar being the shortest and the “+ SFT on D₀, D₁, D₂” bar being the tallest. Specifically, for LLaMA-2-13B, the values are approximately 67% for “no SFT”, 72% for “+ SFT on D₀”, 82% for “+ SFT on D₀, D₁”, and 81% for “+ SFT on D₀, D₁, D₂”. For LLaMA-2-70B, the values are approximately 80% for “no SFT”, 81% for “+ SFT on D₀”, 83% for “+ SFT on D₀, D₁”, and 82% for “+ SFT on D₀, D₁, D₂”. The chart visually emphasizes the performance gains from adding more training data by showing the progressive increase in bar height from left to right within each model group, with the “+ SFT on D₀, D₁” condition generally yielding the highest scores for both models.
